title: Jesus didn’t come for the polished.
paragraphs: Jesus didn’t come for the polished.

Not the ones curating their image.
Not the ones rehearsing perfect prayers.
Not the ones pretending they’re spiritually “fine.”
He came for the ones who know they’re sick.
“It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.” — Luke 5:31

Religion says: Fix yourself first.
Jesus says: Come as you are.

You don’t clean up before going to the doctor.
You go because you’re sick.

If you’ve ever thought,
“I need to get better before I come to God…”
That thought didn’t come from Him.

Read Luke 5 again.
Notice who He calls.
Notice who gets offended.
Notice who leaves changed.

Grace doesn’t meet performance.
Grace meets honesty.
If you’re done pretending — you’re exactly who He’s looking for.
